newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $2.45 bln week of Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $2.45 bln week of Dec 16.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.45 billion in 91 offerings for the week of Dec 16, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $731 million in 67 issues. The largest issue is a $130 million King County, Wash., issue on Monday.
Negotiated sales total $1.7 billion in 24 offerings. The largest is a $626 million New York City deal through Lehman Brothers.
